title: Camera transition when switching (0.9.169)
intro: Release the pawn, Reset Scripts. Stand with the party around you. Press End (or click both sticks) to start.

steps.text: Take over a pawn and come back to the Arisen a few times, and switch from one pawn to another. Watch the camera: it should turn to look at them, slow down a little, then glide behind them.
Done. Tell Claude how it felt: too slow / too fast, too much slow-down, anything odd.

probes.cine_err: local d=_G.DPC_dbg; local R=d and d.R; if not R then return '-' end; return R.cine_err or '-'
probes.ts: local tm=sdk.get_managed_singleton('app.TimeManager'); return tm and string.format('%.2f', tm:call('get_TimeScale')) or '-'
probes.who: local d=_G.DPC_dbg; local s=d and d.state; if not s then return '-' end; return s.active and tostring(s.pawn_name) or 'Arisen'
probes.cam: local d=_G.DPC_dbg; local R=d and d.R; local s=d and d.state; local tgt = (R and R.cine and R.cine.chara) or (s and (s.active and s.pawn_chara or s.arisen_chara)); if not tgt then return '-' end; local tr=sdk.get_primary_camera():call('get_GameObject'):call('get_Transform'); local p=tr:call('get_Position'); local f=tr:call('get_WorldMatrix')[2]; local q=tgt:call('get_GameObject'):call('get_Transform'):call('get_Position'); local dx,dy,dz=q.x-p.x,q.y+1.4-p.y,q.z-p.z; local l=math.sqrt(dx*dx+dy*dy+dz*dz); local c=(-f.x*dx-f.y*dy-f.z*dz)/l; return string.format('%.1fm %ddeg', l, math.floor(math.deg(math.acos(math.max(-1,math.min(1,c))))+0.5))
